# Collection compatibility fixture

`upstream-collection.brsc` was generated by executing the unmodified
`writeCollection` function in `src/renderer/src/utils/formats.js` from
SkAZi/berserk-nxt commit `bf754902127c84baf1a403b0b0bc02e1b1bf417d`.
`upstream-collection.json` is its synthetic input, not user data.

It covers ordinary, foil, alternative foil, second alternative foil,
full-art foil, alternative full-art foil, old foil, alternative old foil,
and nonfoil full-art editions, with printing counts, annotations and prices.
The Rust test compares every field and repeats with Windows line endings
and a UTF-8 BOM, then verifies export/reimport and collection visibility.
